title: Confirm a Transport Delay
wrap_friend: 你剛剛聽懂簡短的交通延誤公告，確認時間，並做出簡單選擇。
scenario: You hear a short train delay announcement and need to decide what to do.
learner_goal: Understand a delay duration and choose whether to wait or take another route.
register_notes: Clear everyday station English. Short public announcement plus polite staff exchange; no refund, compensation, emergency, or complaint flow.
support_text: Ask station staff about a train delay, confirm the time, and choose a simple next step.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Yes. The train to Central is delayed by fifteen minutes.
turns.speak: Yes. The train to Central is delayed by fifteen minutes.
turns.translation: 對，前往 Central 的火車延誤十五分鐘。

friend.hint: The announcement says the delay is fifteen minutes. Confirm that time.

choices.surface: It is delayed by fifteen minutes, right?
choices.speak: It is delayed by fifteen minutes, right?

choices.surface: It leaves in five minutes, right?
choices.speak: It leaves in five minutes, right?
choices.feedback: The announcement says delayed by fifteen minutes, not leaving in five.
This asks about a seat. Here you need to confirm the delay time.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: If you are in a hurry, you can wait here or take the bus outside.
turns.speak: If you are in a hurry, you can wait here or take the bus outside.
turns.translation: 如果您趕時間，可以在這裡等，或搭外面的公車。

friend.hint: Ask if there is another simple option.

inline_explain.title: delayed by + minutes
inline_explain.explain: Use delayed by to say how long the transport is late.

choices.surface: If it is fifteen minutes, I will wait here.
choices.translation: 如果是十五分鐘，我會在這裡等。
choices.speak: If it is fifteen minutes, I will wait here.

choices.feedback: Yesterday does not fit. Ask about another train soon.
This is hotel language. Here you are asking about transport.

choices.surface: Then I will take the bus outside.
choices.speak: Then I will take the bus outside.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: The next train should arrive around ten twenty.
turns.speak: The next train should arrive around ten twenty.
turns.translation: 下一班車大約 10 點 20 分到。

friend.hint: Choose one simple action. Waiting is fine.

choices.surface: Then I will take the train at ten twenty.
choices.translation: 那我搭十點二十分那班車。
choices.speak: Then I will take the train at ten twenty.

choices.feedback: You need to choose what to do now, not talk about yesterday.
This is not a restaurant situation. Choose a transport option.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Okay. Please wait near this platform.
turns.speak: Okay. Please wait near this platform.
turns.translation: 好的，請在這個月台附近等。

friend.hint: The choice is clear. Close politely.

choices.surface: Okay, I will wait here. Thank you.
choices.speak: Okay, I will wait here. Thank you.

choices.feedback: Refund language is outside this practice. A simple thank you is enough.
You are a passenger. Just close politely.

feedback: Distractors test delay duration, current versus past action, and unrelated service language.
tts_segments: Yes. The train to Central is delayed by fifteen minutes.
If you are in a hurry, you can wait here or take the bus outside.
The next train should arrive around ten twenty.
Okay. Please wait near this platform.
runtime_notes: Fresh EN A2 transport candidate. Structural checks and two AI semantic review passes completed on 2026-06-14 before metadata promotion.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored in English from the neutral A2 transport brief. KO was used only as schema-shape reference.
notes.a2_boundary: Simple delay announcement with one duration and one low-risk choice; avoids refund, compensation, complaint, or emergency handling.
notes.scenario_realism_repair_20260615: Reframed from a broadcast-to-dialogue hybrid into a station-staff information request flow: staff states the delay, learner confirms it, staff offers wait/bus options, and the bus option may end the dialogue.
